run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-16T07:19:44Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The alert fired on frontend-proxy's own error spans. Two distinct error populations exist in the evidence. (1) A large burst: from ~07:22 to ~07:34 frontend-proxy returned HTTP 500 on ingress, because frontend's GET /api/data returned 500 and its gRPC call grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds failed with status 14 UNAVAILABLE 'connect ECONNREFUSED 100.70.197.56:8080' - that IP is the ClusterIP of Service ad. The ad Deployment was deliberately rollout-restarted at 07:21:04 (new ReplicaSet ad-785b4464f5 with pod-template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-16T07:21:04Z; old pod ad-554b849958-w5fhc deleted by its ReplicaSet at 07:21:06). The only ad replica was replaced, the new pod was declared Ready at 07:21:06 although Deployment ad defines no readiness/liveness/startup probe, its container printed 'Ad service starting.' only at 07:25:53, and ad served zero oteldemo.AdService/GetAds spans for ~07:24-07:30 while frontend kept sending 78-118 GetAds calls per minute. Serving resumed ~07:30-07:31. (2) A second, smaller and unresolved error population: frontend-proxy returns 503 with response flag 'UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' when the frontend upstream resets the connection; these occur at ~2 per 10 minutes from at least 07:00, i.e. before the ad outage and around the 07:19:44 alert onset, and their origin in frontend was not identified. Affected by their own evidence: frontend-proxy (own error spans), frontend (own 500 and gRPC-14 spans), ad (its own serving gap 07:24-07:30) and the synthetic load-generator (own 500/503 spans; test traffic, not verified customer impact). Checked and showing no errors in the 25-minute window: frontend's CartService/CheckoutService calls, accounting, payment, and the cart/checkout/payment deployments were 1/1 ready. The exact alert rule and the reported value 2.4555 could not be reproduced (no RequestErrorRate rule in this Prometheus and the trace-derived ingress error ratio at 07:19:44 was 0.00117), so the ad rollout explains the dominant error burst but not provably the first firing instant.

claims.text: frontend-proxy emitted error spans in the 25 minutes ending 07:40: 423.07 error spans on operation 'ingress' versus 13,428.80 non-error (STATUS_CODE_UNSET) ingress spans, and 393.65 error spans on operation 'router frontend egress'.

The error burst is time-bounded: 5-minute error increases for frontend 'GET /api/data' and 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' were 0 up to ~07:21, 54.4 at ~07:23, peaked at 297.8 (~07:27-07:29), and returned to 0 by ~07:35; frontend-proxy 'ingress' errors followed the same shape (63.3 at ~07:23, 311.1 at ~07:27, 4.4 at ~07:35).

In traces sampled 07:23-07:27, frontend's span 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' failed with rpc.grpc.status_code=14 and detail '14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ECONNREFUSED 100.70.197.56:8080'; the parent chain visible in the sample is GET /api/data (500) -> executing api route (pages) /api/data (500) -> grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (14), and frontend-proxy 'router frontend egress' and 'ingress' carried http.status_code 500 for the same traces.
The refused address 100.70.197.56 is the ClusterIP of Service 'ad' in namespace otel-demo (ClusterIP 100.70.197.56, port 8080, selector opentelemetry.io/name=ad).

The ad service stopped serving: its server span 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' count per minute went 106 (~07:22) -> 2 (~07:23) -> 0 for ~07:24-07:30 -> 114 (~07:31), with a missing sample at ~07:25, while frontend kept issuing 78-118 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' calls every minute throughout the same period.

Deployment ad runs replicas=1, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad, and defines no readinessProbe, no livenessProbe and no startupProbe, with container resources limits cpu 50m / memory 450Mi; its annotation deployment.kubernetes.io/revision is 2.

Deployment ad was rollout-restarted: ReplicaSet ad-785b4464f5 (created 2026-11-16T07:21:04Z, revision 2) carries pod-template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-16T07:21:04Z, while the previous ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 (revision 1) has no such annotation; both ReplicaSets have the identical container image, env and resources, i.e. a configuration-only change.

ad events in the window: 'Stopping container ad' and 'Deleted pod: ad-554b849958-w5fhc' by ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 at 07:21:06, and 'Successfully assigned/Created pod: ad-785b4464f5-9bshh', image already present, container created and started 07:21:04-07:21:06. No Evicted, OOMKilled, Failed or Unhealthy event is present for ad.

The replacement ad pod ad-785b4464f5-9bshh was Ready=True from 07:21:06 (container startedAt 07:21:06, restartCount 0, lastState empty), yet its application logged 'Ad service starting.' only at 07:25:53 - i.e. Kubernetes reported it ready ~4m47s before the app logged startup, because no probe gates readiness.

The replacement ad pod was serving ad requests again in logs from 07:30:54 onward ('Targeted ad request received for [...]', 'Non-targeted ad request received...'), and its only Service endpoint at query time is pod ad-785b4464f5-9bshh (100.96.3.224:8080).

A separate error population existed before the ad outage: frontend-proxy log lines at 07:13:48, 07:15:08 and 07:15:24 record HTTP 503 with flag 'UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' for 'GET /api/cart', 'GET /' and 'GET /api/products/6E92ZMYYFZ', and the matching pod egress spans carry error="true", http.status_code=0, while the trace contains no frontend span for the failing request (e.g. trace 8e64f08e8618106f37c3213bf22c8e8e: load-generator GET 503 -> frontend-proxy ingress 503 -> router frontend egress status 0, with a separate successful POST /api/cart 200 in the same trace).

10-minute increases of frontend-proxy 'ingress' error spans were 2.26 (07:05), 2.11 (07:10), 2.11 (07:15), 6.32 (07:20), then 188.4 (07:25), 430.5 (07:30), 250.5 (07:35) and 4.25 (07:40); 'router frontend egress' error spans counted by OTel status were 0 before 07:25. So a low, steady error signal preceded the 07:21 ad restart.

At the alert start instant 07:19:44 the trace-derived ingress error ratio for frontend-proxy (5-minute window) was 0.00117 (0.117%), which does not reproduce the alert annotation value 2.4555; the Prometheus target contains no rule named RequestErrorRate.

In the 25 minutes ending 07:40, non-zero error-span series were confined to frontend (GET, GET /api/data, executing api route /api/data, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, tcp.connect), frontend-proxy (ingress, router frontend egress) plus small flagd EventStream errors on ad/fraud-detection/recommendation (~1-2); frontend's grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, CartService/AddItem, CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, /api/cart and /api/checkout error series were 0, as were accounting 'orders receive' and payment GET/dns.lookup/tcp.connect.

ad's own server spans never carried an error status: 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' shows only STATUS_CODE_UNSET (662.8 over 25m, when it was serving), i.e. the failures were connection-level and observed on frontend's client spans, not as ad server error spans.

At query time all 21 deployments in otel-demo, including ad, frontend and frontend-proxy, reported 1 ready and 1 available replica; all 21 pods were Running and Ready with restart counts 0 except fraud-detection (1).

Primary cause of the dominant error burst: the configuration-only rollout restart of Deployment ad at 07:21:04 replaced its only replica, and because the Deployment has no readiness/startup probe the new pod was marked Ready at 07:21:06 and advertised through Service ad while the ad process was not yet listening; frontend's GetAds calls were refused (gRPC 14, ECONNREFUSED to Service ad's ClusterIP 100.70.197.56:8080) from ~07:22 until ad resumed serving ~07:30-07:31, which turned GET /api/data into 500 and produced the frontend-proxy ingress errors that dominate the alert period.

Secondary candidate for the alert's onset at 07:19:44 (before the ad outage): the chronic 503 'UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' responses, in which the frontend upstream resets the connection before responding, gave frontend-proxy a small non-zero ingress error rate from at least 07:00 (2.1-2.3 error spans per 10 minutes) and are unexplained by the ad fault.

The ~5-10 minute window between the ad container starting (07:21:06) and the app listening/serving (~07:25:53 log line, spans from ~07:31) may have been extended by the 50m CPU limit on the ad container and/or its flagd dependency; this mechanism is not verified because container CPU throttling metrics were not examined.

Rejected: that the ad pod crashed, was OOMKilled or Evicted. The replacement pod has restartCount 0, empty lastState, no previous container instance, and the events for ad are only Kill/Delete/Scheduled/Pulled/Created/Started (controller-driven rollout), with no OOMKilled, Evicted, Failed or Unhealthy event.

Rejected: that cart, checkout or payment dependency failures caused the frontend 500s. Frontend's grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, CartService/AddItem and CheckoutService/PlaceOrder error series were 0 in the window and accounting/payment error series were 0; the only failing frontend operation in the burst traces was grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds.

Rejected: that frontend-proxy itself mis-routed or failed the 500 requests. In the burst traces its 'router frontend egress' span recorded http.status_code 500 from the frontend upstream and the ingress span propagated that 500; frontend-proxy was forwarding correctly, and its own separate 503/UC resets are a different failure mode.

The ad pods themselves did not report damage or restart: all otel-demo pods were Running/Ready at query time and Deployment ad reported 1 ready/available replica, so a persistent ad outage is not observable after ~07:31; the ad error was a transient availability gap, not a continuing failure.

Add a readinessProbe (and preferably a startupProbe) on the ad container's port 8080 so Service ad never routes to a pod whose process is not listening, and consider replicas>=2 with maxUnavailable 0 for ad so a restart of the single replica cannot remove all serving capacity; also re-examine the 50m CPU limit for the ad container.

Investigate the independent frontend upstream resets behind the 503 'UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' responses (frontend application logs and Envoy upstream/keepalive settings), since they are the error signal present when the alert first fired and are not explained by the ad rollout.

Review the RequestErrorRate alert definition: it fires 'above 0', which makes a chronic ~0.2 errors/minute background enough to alert, and its reported value 2.4555 could not be reproduced from the available trace metric; align the rule expression/threshold with the intended request-error-ratio basis.

gaps: The alerting rule RequestErrorRate is not present in the registered Prometheus (list_prometheus_rules returned no rule with that name), so the alert expression, threshold and the reported value 2.4555 could not be verified; no Alertmanager state is queryable to confirm whether the alert is still firing after 07:40.

Who or what issued the kubectl rollout restart of Deployment ad at 07:21:04 is unknown: only the pod-template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt and deployment revision 2 exist, and the change_history integration is not available.

The origin of the chronic frontend upstream resets (503 UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}) is unidentified; frontend application logs returned no lines for 07:20-07:40 and the frontend-proxy container log was readable only through ~07:31:55, so nothing about the frontend side of those resets was observed.
It is not verified whether the ad container's 50m CPU limit throttled its startup; container CPU/throttling metrics were not queried.
Trace-derived metric samples end at 07:40, so error-rate behaviour in the last minutes of the authorized window (07:40-07:43:56) is unknown.

kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready returned no data for the ad/frontend/frontend-proxy selector, so deployment ready-replica history during the gap could not be examined (only the current API state was available).

Not checked: currency, email, product-catalog, quote, shipping, image-provider, kafka, flagd and otel-collector health beyond their pod phase/Running-Ready status; fraud-detection showed one container restart with only low-volume flagd EventStream error spans and its relation to this incident was not established.
No evidence of real customer impact: all failing requests observed came from the load-generator; downstream/customer consequences are unverified.
next_steps: Retrieve the RequestErrorRate alert rule definition and its evaluation history from the Alertmanager/rule source that owns it, to reconcile the reported 2.4555 with the trace-derived error ratios.
Add a readiness and startup probe to the ad container and give ad more than one replica before any further rollout restart, then re-run the rollout to confirm no GetAds gap.

Fetch frontend application logs and Envoy upstream connection settings for the 503 UC resets in a time range where log retention exists (the window's frontend logs were empty and proxy logs ended ~07:31:55).
Check container CPU throttling metrics for the ad pod's 07:21-07:31 startup interval to confirm or drop the CPU-limit hypothesis.
Consult change/audit history (currently not integrated) for the actor and reason behind the 07:21:04 rollout restart of Deployment ad.
